verdict.rationale:
GrowthBook's targeting docs explicitly support conditions on user attributes plus 'saved groups' for grouping specific users (e.g., beta testers, internal accounts), and rules can be scoped to specific users based on any attribute like user ID or email. This directly supports allowlisting/excluding individual users on a flag.
missing for 10: a concrete walkthrough example of building an ID-based allowlist or 'internal users' beta group, and independent/community confirmation of this specific use case beyond general targeting docs.
